data.name: Waifus VS Robots
data.detailed_description:
They Took Their Loved Ones. Big Mistake.

The robots took control and abducted the people who mattered most. But they made one small miscalculation: they left behind a group of girls who have no intention of sitting around and doing nothing.

Gear up, get ready for a storm of bullets, and charge headfirst into an army of machines in a 2.5D action roguelite inspired by classic run-and-gun games.

Run, shoot, dodge, blow up robots, and upgrade your arsenal as you fight your way through stages filled with enemies, traps, and chaos. Every run is different, so you'll have to adapt, experiment with your weapons, and find the best way to make it to the end.

Run. Shoot. Destroy. Repeat.

Don't expect a perfectly organized military operation. The strategy here is simple:

If it moves, shoot it!

Take on hordes of robots, giant machines, and increasingly dangerous enemies as you fight to recover the people who were taken from you.

2.5D Action

Experience the classic arcade action of run-and-gun games combined with a dynamic 2.5D world packed with explosions, enemies, and chaos.

Enjoy fast-paced, frantic combat where you'll have to keep moving constantly to survive.

Arsenal & Upgrades

Find and use different weapons to adapt to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear, experiment with different combinations, and discover which arsenal works best for each situation.

Because when you have an entire army of robots standing in your way...

You can never have too many guns.

An Army of Robots Won't Stop Them

From small enemies to massive war machines, every area will put your skills to the test.

And when a giant robot finally shows up...

Run.
Shoot.
Blow everything up.

Every Run Is Different

As a true roguelite, every run brings new challenges and opportunities.

Learn from your mistakes, improve your skills, and try again. Maybe this time you'll find the perfect weapon combination... or maybe you'll end up as scrap metal.

But you can always try again.

They're Not Here to Save the World

They're not trying to become heroes.

They don't want to save humanity.

They just want to get back the people they love.

And if getting them back means fighting their way through an entire army of robots...

So be it.

Get ready for an adventure packed with bullets, explosions, giant robots, and absolute chaos.

The robots made the mistake of taking the wrong people.

Now they're coming for them.
